name: qa-bug-repro
description: Bug reproduction and triage: well-formed bug reports, minimal failing tests built from issue reports, and CI failure classification before a fix starts. Also classifies production escapes by root gap. Agents (bug-report-from-recording, bug-repro-builder, defect-pipeline-runner) turn Playwright traces and HAR files into bug reports, build the repro test, and run the weekly defect review that clusters the backlog and narrates trends.
